extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) leading to Remote Code Execution — Full remote code execution on the server. An attacker can read arbitrary files, exfiltrate environment variables and secrets, execute OS commands, pivot to internal network resources, or achieve full host compromise. [verified: The `username` query parameter is concatenated directly into the Jinja2 template source string at line 13 (`Jinja2.from_string("Welcome " + username + "!").render()`), so attacker-supplied Jinja2 expressions (e.g. `{{7*7}}` or RCE chains via `__subclasses__`) are parsed and executed by an unsandboxed `Environment()`. There is no input validation, sanitization, authentication, or sandboxing anywher]
